title: Feature Request: A toggle button or checkbox for auto-connecting to a Wifi Network
line: Saved Wi-Fi networks in the Networks widget now have a "Connect automatically" checkbox, so you can stop a network from connecting by itself without opening System Settings.
explanation: The Networks widget had no way to see or change whether a saved Wi-Fi network connects automatically: NetworkManager saves new networks with autoconnect on, and turning it off meant opening the connection editor in System Settings. The network model now exposes each connection's autoconnect flag, the handler gains setAutoconnect() which updates the saved connection, and the expanded view of a saved Wi-Fi network shows a "Connect automatically" checkbox below its details.

commits.message:
applet: add a "Connect automatically" checkbox for saved Wi-Fi networks

Turning off automatic connection for a Wi-Fi network meant opening the
connection editor in System Settings. Show a checkbox below the details
of saved Wi-Fi networks that changes the connection's autoconnect flag.

BUG: 528062

media.caption: Saved network HomeNet expanded: only Configure… and Forget…, no auto-connect option
Saved network HomeNet expanded: a "Connect automatically" checkbox below the details, checked
Expanding HomeNet, unchecking and re-checking "Connect automatically"; NetworkManager receives autoconnect off, then on
After unchecking: the checkbox follows the saved connection's autoconnect setting

review.text: The UX placement and overall model/handler wiring are clean and directly address the request, but error handling has a state-corruption bug: Handler::setAutoconnectInternal() mutates NetworkManager::Connection's shared cached settings in place before con->update() succeeds, and the QML CheckBox stays visually stuck on the unsaved state if the D-Bus update fails (e.g. cancelled Polkit prompt). AutoconnectRole is also misplaced under the writable-roles section in NetworkModel.
changes: In Handler::setAutoconnectInternal() (libs/handler.cpp), do not mutate con->settings() in place before con->update() succeeds; work on a copy of the settings/map (or revert on failure) so a failed/cancelled update does not corrupt cached settings and block retries.

In applet/ConnectionItem.qml, keep the CheckBox checked state bound to connectionItem.model.Autoconnect on failure (e.g. capture the toggled value and restore Qt.binding(() => connectionItem.model.Autoconnect) in onToggled, or resync on error) so a rejected update does not leave the checkbox displaying the wrong state.

In libs/models/networkmodel.h, move AutoconnectRole above the '// writable roles' comment since setData() only handles DelayModelUpdatesRole (and optionally ignore AutoconnectRole in NetworkModel::updateItem()'s detailsChangedRoles check to avoid rebuilding ConnectionDetailsModel).
